# ANALYSIS: TRENDLINE_BREAK_CALL_VETO_CALL_IMPACT

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** call-veto impact analysis  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The TRENDLINE_BREAK_CALL_VETO gate, when enabled, vetoes CALL entries when a bearish structure break is detected (5m-close-through-respected-ascending-support). The hypothesis is that this veto avoids losing CALL trades on days where the structure breaks before spurious counter-trend CALL entries, thereby improving CALL-side P&L without affecting PUT winners.

## Mechanism

Entry: CALL entries are generated by the BULLISH_RECLAIM_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup (or other CALL triggers). The gate reads the structure-state.json flag `trendline_break_call_veto` (default OFF). When ON, if the flag indicates a bearish structure break (i.e., an ascending support has been broken on the 5m chart), the CALL entry is suppressed. Exit logic remains unchanged (chart stop, profit-lock, etc.). The gate is placed in the entry path after signal derivation but before order submission.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 contracts requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account realizes ~14% of headline P&L (per leaderboard note for TRENDLINE_BREAK_CALL_VETO).

2. **Sample bias:** Sample is the full 16-month OPRA real-fills window (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18). Selection method: all CALL entries that would have been taken by the engine under the current rule set, filtered by the call-veto condition. Overfit risk: the gate is based on a structural break detection validated on J anchor day 5/07 but may not generalize; OOS walk-forward needed to assess.

3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window not yet performed).

4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (real-fills A/B with enable/disable call-veto knob not yet run on top 3 J days).

5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: veto incorrectly blocks a winning CALL entry, turning a profit into a loss.
   - Max drawdown: increase if many winning CALLs are vetoed.
   - Blow-up scenario: gate too loose (fails to block losing CALLs) yields no benefit; gate too tight (blocks winners) degrades P&L.

6. **Concentration:** Unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest to compute what proportion of P&L change comes from top 5 days.

## Pre-merge gate

- Gym validators for gate logic (unit tests) must pass.
- Walk-forward analysis: OOS positive expectancy and WF >= 0.70.
- Real-fills validation on top 3 J days: simulated vs real OPRA fill diff < ±20%.
- OP-16 anchor regression test: no regression on PUT winners; measurable reduction in CALL losers on 5/07 (and other loser days if applicable).

## Confidence

3 / 10 -- needs OOS real-fills A/B to quantify impact on CALL entries and walk-forward stability.
